name: Anonindo SEO Friendly LLMs.txt
author: anonymoustech

sections.description:
Anonindo SEO Friendly LLMs.txt helps WordPress site owners publish a structured llms.txt file for AI crawlers and assistants.

Features:

  • Modern admin dashboard with snapshot preview
  • Manual build button plus realtime, daily, or manual refresh modes
  • Curated post type selection
  • Smart summary and extended summary modes
  • Manual priority URLs and excluded URLs
  • Optional modified date and taxonomy output
  • Known AI crawler request logging
  • Physical file write when possible, virtual serving fallback when not
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/anonindo-seo-friendly-llms-txt/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Open LLMs.txt in the admin menu
  4. Save your preferences and generate the file
